scope: Offline long-only SimplePolicyOptimiser challenger. It adds a source-aligned richer exit simulator and a pre-2025-only HPO/replay runner; it does not alter live execution, live state, frozen incumbent artifacts, exchange configuration, or open-position exits.

fixed_contract.routing: long-only, strict-prequential upstream scores; the pre-2025 global top-5% score cutoff is frozen before 2025/2026 evaluation
fixed_contract.time: decision timestamp is the entry 15-minute-bar open; outcomes use the following 48 complete 15-minute bars (H12)
fixed_contract.cost: 100 bps exactly once in the source-aligned simulator
fixed_contract.portfolio: two concurrent, two entries per decision timestamp, one per asset; frozen score priority for both arms
fixed_contract.selection: Jan-Jun 2024 calibrates ATR scale/fast-adverse severity; Jul-Dec 2024 selects the challenger; 2025 and 2026 are not used by HPO

properties: No live configuration, exchange I/O, state, or position monitor is touched.
No H12 outcome availability field is used for score routing; missing paths are excluded only from outcome measurement and recorded as coverage.
All candidate/path identities are preserved through the portfolio auction.
The incumbent runs through the identical simulator and portfolio constraints.
